text:
Media reports indicate that Trump's statements about the size of the crowd lack a solid foundation(Image: Getty Images)

Attendance at President Donald Trump's failed Great American State Fair fell far short of expectations, despite the president's claims of a great turnout.

While the precise number of visitors who attended America 250 and the president "Salute to America" speech is unclear, President Trump has offered varying figures. Over the weekend, he claimed to have attracted 375,000 on Saturday, then increased the estimate to 422,000 on Sunday.

However, as of Monday, he said the event turnout was 152,000. While there is no evidence that any number provided by the president is accurate, his highest estimate still falls short of the Bicentennial parade in 1976, which had 500,000 attendees, according to the New York Times, which reported on the event at the time. It comes as Trump's 'disgusting' bedroom habits were revealed.

The president's grand speech, which featured military flyovers and demonstrations every hour leading up to the event, was delayed after severe weather rolled into the area, forcing an evacuation of the Great American State Fair and the National Mall. Around 9 p.m., the president announced he would be speaking and that the fireworks would go on as planned.

“There’s no way we can be deterred,” Trump, 80, said during his speech. " They estimated they had 375,000 people before everybody had to leave, and they now have 150,000 people. It’s the craziest thing anyone’s ever seen.”

The Republican president has a track record of inflating the size of crowds(Image: AFP via Getty Images)

He claimed that he personally overturned the decision to cancel the event and waited for attendees to gradually return to the Mall before beginning his speech after 11 p.m. “Incredibly, at least 150,000 people returned, and it was an even more spectacular evening than it would have been as normalized!"

"It showed work under pressure," he added. "Congratulations to the Secret Service and Law Enforcement on being able to get so many people back into the Arena in such rapid fashion!" Trump wrote. It's worth noting that the Republican president has a track record of inflating crowd sizes.

On Sunday, the president increased the estimate of people who attended the speech to 422,000(Image: AFP via Getty Images)

Shortly after his inauguration in 2017, his then-press secretary claimed it was the "largest audience to ever see an inauguration," despite reports that attendance was far lower than that of Barack Obama's 2009 inauguration. A series of setbacks overshadowed Trump's grand plans for America's semiquincentennial, including the withdrawal of musical performers and several Democratic-led states, a power outage, weather-related disruptions, and what appeared to be lower-than-expected attendance.

Crowd size was a major topic of discussion at the fair's debut. On social media, images and messages from the fair showing a deserted mall and small-audience performances went viral.

Several weather-related setbacks overshadowed the president's grand plans for America's 250th birthday. (Image: Matt Kaminsky/ZUMA Press Wire/Shutterstock)

Trump responded to the attendance backlash on Truth Social, calling out past presidents by name – even if he misspelled them: “Do you think people appreciate what a fantastic job we did in building and operating the Great American State Fair at the National Mall, packed with happy people, and everybody loving it? Ask yourself this simple question, ‘DO YOU THINK THAT OBUMA OR SLEEPY JOE BIDEN COULD HAVE DONE IT?’ THE ANSWER IS NO!”

Meanwhile, Trump was caught on camera doing a shocking act to Melania at an inappropriate moment.
